user_saw: Some selected controls kept the same background when hovered, and sidebar rail buttons used the same fill for hover and selection.
summary: The fix standardized hover, selection, and selected-hover backgrounds across the Control UI while keeping rail badge cutouts matched to their controls.
reasoning: The original sidebar rail deliberately grouped hover and selection under the same background rule, and the prior session-row test expected the active fill to stay fixed on hover. The PR’s visual comparisons and updated tests establish a new styling convention while preserving the existing multi-selection highlight.
